Piper phonemization browser assets from @diffusionstudio/piper-wasm 1.0.0, publisher commit 69522c832bd52d7c16389e9a8aee568065027689. npm package declares MIT; its archive has no separate LICENSE file. Piper-phonemize upstream is MIT; embedded eSpeak NG is GPLv3. Retain the accompanying upstream license texts. Original build recipe is preserved in BUILD-SOURCE.md. It pins Emscripten 3.1.47 but does not pin engine source revisions. Build source projects: https://github.com/wide-video/piper-wasm ; https://github.com/wide-video/piper-phonemize ; https://github.com/rhasspy/espeak-ng . Emscripten source/license: https://github.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/tree/3.1.47 . No claim is made that current upstream source reproduces this package byte-for-byte. Local change: ESM export only, no engine modification.

Fixed complete source and build instructions for this distribution are provided alongside the binary release: https://github.com/Tomorrowhopless/wordworkshop/releases/download/v4.7.0/phonemizer-source-4.7.0.tar.gz . Precise engine/wrapper/data source commits and 327 byte-matched voice/language files are recorded in provenance.json and the archive SOURCE-EVIDENCE.json; build reproduction has not been performed locally.
